sentence: This project uses deep learning to turn on just enough sensors and compress their data, so wearable sensor computers use less power.
This project studies how two kinds of seaweed in Antarctic waters differ in their genes and growth at different depths and light.
This project builds a software library that speeds up matrix and tensor computations on many kinds of computer hardware.
This project builds a framework that puts artificial intelligence into how wireless networks are monitored and controlled so they decide automatically.
This project tests a blood test that measures cancer signals carried by tiny particles released by tumor cells.
This project builds deep learning methods that recognize and measure pancreatic cells in microscopy images in ways people can understand.
This project builds welding robots that learn to predict how a weld will evolve before they act, so they can adapt and make safer decisions.
This project studies how communities between South Florida and Puerto Rico adapt through their culture to changes in the environment and climate.
This project studies how sound waves travel in a medium made of a single-atom-thick membrane stretched over an array of nanoscale cavities.
This project uses satellite images to study how invasive plants spread and how hurricanes and fires affect them in southern Florida.
This project builds robots that travel inside gas pipelines to find cracks and leaks and predicts the risk that a pipeline will fail.
This project builds a software tool that helps pathologists find cancer areas in tissue images by combining two kinds of image features.
This project studies a flow battery made from organic materials, without a membrane, and uses machine learning to forecast when the battery will decline.
This project tries to find ways to sort shapes defined by polynomial equations into groups.
This project builds a network of researchers that helps materials data be shared and used with artificial intelligence and machine learning.
This project builds software scenarios for testing how artificial intelligence agents can be attacked and how to defend them.
This project studies how four species of seabirds search for food and how their diet and movement affect reproductive success.
This project builds a framework for teaching how machine learning and cybersecurity can defend cyberinfrastructure against cyberattacks.
